description.value: Medicine Beach Nature Sanctuary is a protected natural area on Pender Island managed by the Pender Island Conservancy. The site preserves a rare coastal ecosystem including a sandy beach and maritime meadow. Cyclists touring the Southern Gulf Islands would find it a scenic natural stop accessible by the island's road network.
